pundit.name: Eric Wynalda
pundit.take:
"The Noisemaker" should focus more on schoolwork than assembling a fantasy soccer team. Look, Rafe, or "The Noisemaker" as he likes to call himself, had the audacity to pick Germany as his Tier 1 team despite their recent struggles on the world stage. Pairing them with picks like Uzbekistan and Scotland, who have the attacking prowess of a Sunday league, questions whether he even knows the rules of this sport or just recognizes these countries from FIFA video games. In the Mexico vs. England clash, the odds are firmly stacked against him as Gayden's "Backpass Assassin" squad is likely to dismantle Mexico, sending Rafe back to dreaming of his non-qualifying heroes.

Meanwhile, Zach, aka "Mustard Boy," somehow ended up drafting a mix of underachievers like Switzerland and Austria. Facing Devin's "Ghost Pepper" in today's Brazil vs. Norway match, it's painfully obvious that Zach's unbalanced roster won't stand a chance against anyone fielding a Tier 1 like Brazil, even if Devin can't really match any significant strategy with his Tier 2 and Tier 3 choices. Expect Brazil to cruise through Norway as if they're taking a leisurely stroll through Central Park. If there's any manager with a clue, it's Gunner, sitting at the top without any of these laughable inconsistencies. These guys could use a lesson in the reality of the sport, maybe from someone who's scored in a World Cup, like me.
